images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 2005 Wayne St

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a 1.5-storey gable-front bungalow-cottage with paired gable windows, a hipped full porch with a spindle rail, a side bay; bare elms on the terrace, two-storey neighbours tight on both sides
